brief: 6 luxurious self-care rituals that cost less than a coffee.

slots.subtitle: SIX RITUALS TO ELEVATE YOUR DAILY ROUTINE

slots.title: FACIAL MASSAGE
slots.body: Use clean fingertips to gently sweep from the center of your face outward along jaw and cheekbones. This simple ritual drains tension, reduces puffiness, and restores a lifted, luminous glow in under five minutes.

slots.title: AROMA STEAM
slots.body: Drape a warm, herb-infused towel over your face and breathe slowly for three minutes. The gentle heat opens pores, softens skin, and calms the mind without spending a single extra penny.

slots.title: SCALP RITUAL
slots.body: Warm a teaspoon of coconut or olive oil between your palms and massage into your scalp with slow, circular motions. This nourishes roots, stimulates circulation, and invites a deep sense of calm before bed.

slots.title: BODY POLISH
slots.body: Blend one tablespoon of sugar with a drizzle of honey or body oil to create a sumptuous scrub. Massage over damp skin in gentle circles to reveal silky softness and a healthy, radiant glow.

slots.title: FOOT SOAK
slots.body: Fill a basin with warm water and a handful of Epsom salts or fresh herbs. Soak for ten minutes while the minerals ease tired muscles and leave your feet feeling pampered and light.

slots.title: EYE COMPRESS
slots.body: Chill two chamomile tea bags or cucumber slices, then place them over closed eyes for five minutes. The coolness soothes delicate skin, diminishes puffiness, and delivers a spa-worthy refresh to your gaze.

slots.headline: START TODAY
slots.body: Choose one ritual tonight and notice how your skin and spirit respond.
